text:
I can't see this meal after eating, so the leftover figure is only a guess. These are estimates from the photo.

Estimated calories served, by item:
- Sushi rolls (8 pieces) and a spring roll: about 400 kcal
- Greek-style salad with feta: about 150 kcal
- Grilled cheese and tomato sandwich: about 300 kcal
- Tea: about 10 kcal
- Orange juice: about 110 kcal
- Fruit salad: about 80 kcal
- Cream cake: about 300 kcal

That adds up to roughly 1350 kcal served.

I assumed about 15% would be left over, around 200 kcal. That leaves about 1150 kcal eaten.

For the macros of the amount eaten, I assumed about 15% protein, 55% carbohydrate and 30% fat of the calories. That works out to about 40 g protein, 155 g carbohydrate and 40 g fat.
